name: opcua-bounded-context-aware-binary-decoding
instr:
gopcua's OPC UA binary codec cannot safely decode untrusted input with explicit cumulative byte, element, and nesting limits. Add bounded decoding that remains context-aware across protocol-specific values, registered bodies, and service envelopes. Successful results must be interchangeable with the existing codec.

Each bounded decode uses one independent policy shared across primitive reads, reflected values, built-in decoders, recursive values, registered ExtensionObjects, and service envelopes. Reject wire-declared collections and payloads before allocation or iteration when their cumulative element allowance is exceeded. Sibling values release nesting depth without restoring byte or element budgets.

Preserve compact NodeID and ExpandedNodeID semantics while charging identifier payloads and optional fields. Registered binary ExtensionObject bodies must respect their declared boundary and remaining allowance. Unknown binary and XML bodies preserve established outcomes while charging declared content.

Limit violations and malformed or truncated nested input return Go-compatible DecodeError values with the applicable limit, complete meaningful path, and deterministic absolute consumed offset. DecodeWithOptions and DecodeServiceWithOptions must report consumption consistently with existing entry points. A service TypeID and its concrete registered body share one uninterrupted policy.
